fields.options:
Guide: Notification Hub overview

Notification Hub is the central place for sending ERPNext messages through Telegram and WhatsApp. Every setting, notification, template and group is managed from this page.

Tabs
TabPurpose
NotificationsAutomatic messages sent when something happens to a document (created, submitted, status changed, due date approaching, etc.).
User AlertsForwards the system notifications that users receive in the bell to their WhatsApp or Telegram.
TemplatesA library of reusable messages that notifications and user alerts can use.
GroupsWhatsApp and Telegram groups that can receive notifications.
Telegram / WhatsAppConnection settings for each channel.
TestSends a single test message to verify a channel or a group.
Recommended setup order
  1. Set the Default Country Code below. Local numbers such as 01001234567 are converted to international format with it (Egypt = 20).
  2. Configure and enable a channel in the Telegram or WhatsApp tab.
  3. Send a message from the Test tab to confirm the channel works.
  4. Add your Groups and Templates, if required.
  5. Create Notifications and User Alerts.
  6. Monitor the delivery of every message in Hub Message Log. A failed message can be resent with Retry.
Delivery Trip and Transportation Request messages to drivers are handled separately and are not configured here, except for the driver group chat id in the Telegram tab.

Guide: Notifications

Each row is one automatic notification. Click Add Row to create a notification, or Edit to change one. All settings are made in the dialog; no code is required.

Settings
SettingDescription
DocumentThe document type the notification applies to, e.g. Sales Invoice or Delivery Trip.
EventWhen the notification is sent (see the table below).
ChannelWhatsApp, Telegram or Both, for the people selected under Send To. Groups always use their own channel.
ConditionsOptional filters, e.g. Status = Completed or Grand Total > 1000. The notification is sent only when all conditions are met.
Send ToThe document's customer or contact, specific users, every user with a role, fixed mobile numbers, a person stored on the document (e.g. Created By), and groups.
MessageSelect a saved template or write the message. Use Insert Field to add document values and Preview to view the result with a real document.
Attach PDFAttaches the document as a PDF using the selected Print Format.
Events
EventSent when
NewThe document is created.
SaveThe document is saved.
Submit / CancelThe document is submitted or cancelled.
Value ChangeThe selected field changes, e.g. Status changes from In Transit to Delivered.
Days Before / Days AfterA number of days before or after a date field, e.g. 2 days before the Due Date. Checked once a day.
Message placeholders
PlaceholderValue
{{ doc.fieldname }}Any field of the document, e.g. {{ doc.customer_name }}
{{ doc.get_formatted("grand_total") }}A field formatted with currency, date format, etc.
{{ link }}A link that opens the document
{{ changed_by }}Full name of the user who made the change
{{ field_label }}, {{ old_value }}, {{ new_value }}Value Change only: the field name, its previous value and its new value
{{ subject }}User Alerts only: the notification text as it appears in the bell
The Notify Customer button on a Sales Invoice uses the enabled Sales Invoice notification and sends it to the customer only.

fields.description: Each row is one notification. Click Edit to set the event, conditions, recipients and message, no code needed.

Guide: User Alerts

User Alerts forward the notifications that users receive in the system bell (for example Delivery Trip MAT-DT-0050 status changed from Ended to Reviewed) to WhatsApp or Telegram. Click Add Row to create an alert, or Edit to change one.

Settings
SettingDescription
ForA single user, or every user who has a role.
Send onWhatsApp, Telegram or Both.
TypesWhich notifications are forwarded. Leave empty to forward all types.
DocumentsWhich document types are forwarded, e.g. Delivery Trip. Leave empty to forward all documents.
TemplateOptional. Without a template, the message contains the notification text and a link to the document.
Notification types
TypeDescription
AlertStatus changes and notifications created by the system or by notification rules.
AssignmentA document has been assigned to the user.
MentionThe user has been mentioned in a comment.
ShareA document has been shared with the user.
Energy PointEnergy points have been awarded or reviewed.
Requirements
  • WhatsApp: the user must have a Mobile No in their User record.
  • Telegram (Bot mode): the user must link their Telegram account once. Open the alert, click Get Telegram Link for this user and send the link to the user.

fields.description: Forward the system notifications (the bell: status changes, assignments, mentions, shares) to users on WhatsApp / Telegram. Click Edit to choose which notifications and documents.

Guide: Templates

Templates are reusable messages. A notification or a user alert can select a template instead of its own message. When a template is edited, every notification and alert that uses it is updated automatically.

Creating a template
  1. Click Add Row, enter a name, and optionally select the document it is intended for.
  2. Write the message. Use Insert Field to add document values and Preview to check the result.
  3. Alternatively, write a message inside a notification and click Save as Template.
Placeholders
PlaceholderValue
{{ doc.fieldname }}Any field of the document, e.g. {{ doc.customer_name }}
{{ doc.get_formatted("grand_total") }}A field formatted with currency, date format, etc.
{{ link }}A link that opens the document
{{ changed_by }}Full name of the user who made the change
{{ field_label }}, {{ old_value }}, {{ new_value }}Value Change only: the field name, its previous value and its new value
{{ subject }}User Alerts only: the notification text as it appears in the bell
Example
Dear {{ doc.customer_name }},
Your order {{ doc.name }} is now {{ doc.status }}.
{% if doc.delivery_date %}Expected delivery: {{ doc.get_formatted("delivery_date") }}{% endif %}
{{ link }}
Using a template

Click Add Notification on a template row to create a notification that uses that template. Select the event and the recipients, then click Save. A template can also be selected from the Message section of any notification. The Used In column lists the notifications and user alerts that use the template.

fields.description: Reusable messages. Pick one in a notification or user alert; editing it here updates everyone who uses it.

Guide: Groups

Groups defined here can be selected under Send To > Groups in any notification. Each group receives messages on its own channel.

WhatsApp groups
  1. Wapilot API v2 is required, and the connected WhatsApp number must be a member of the group.
  2. Run WhatsApp Diagnostics in the WhatsApp tab to list your groups, or obtain the group id from the Wapilot dashboard.
  3. The group id ends with @g.us, e.g. 120363012345678901@g.us.
Telegram groups
  1. Telegram must be in Bot mode, and the bot must be added to the group as a member.
  2. The chat id is a negative number, e.g. -1001234567890. In Telegram Web, it appears in the address bar when the group is open.
Before using a group in a notification, please verify it from the Test tab by entering its id as the Test Recipient.
Sending notifications to a group

Click Add Notification on a group row to create a notification that is sent to that group. Select the document, the event and the message or template, then click Save. The Used In column lists the notifications that send to the group.

fields.description: WhatsApp and Telegram groups that notifications can be sent to.

fields.options:
Guide: Telegram

Telegram can send messages in one of two modes:

ModeDescriptionRequirement
Bot (recommended)The official and safest method. Messages are sent by your bot.Each recipient must open their personal link and press Start once. Groups are supported.
User AccountMessages are sent from a regular Telegram account using the recipient's phone number.The number must be registered on Telegram. Please use a dedicated number, as high volumes may cause the account to be restricted.
Bot setup
  1. In Telegram, open @BotFather, send /newbot and copy the token.
  2. Enable Telegram, select Mode = Bot, paste the Bot Token and save.
  3. Click Test Connection. The Bot Username is filled automatically.
  4. Select the Link Method: Polling for internal servers, or Webhook if the site has a public HTTPS address (then click Set Webhook).
User Account setup
  1. Obtain the api_id and api_hash from https://my.telegram.org (API development tools).
  2. Enter them with the Login Phone and save.
  3. Click Send Code, enter the code received in the Telegram app, then click Verify & Login.

The Driver Notifications Group Chat ID is the Telegram group that receives Delivery Trip and Transportation Request details.

fields.label: Driver Notifications Group Chat ID
fields.description: Telegram group that receives Delivery Trip / Transportation Request details. For other groups use the Groups tab.

Guide: WhatsApp

WhatsApp messages are sent through the Wapilot gateway. Recipients do not need to link anything; their mobile number is sufficient.

Setup
  1. In the Wapilot dashboard, connect your WhatsApp number and confirm that it is active.
  2. Copy the API token and the Instance ID.
  3. Enable WhatsApp and enter the token and the Base URL:
    APIBase URL
    API v2 (recommended)https://api.wapilot.net/api/v2/INSTANCE_ID/send-message
    Classic SDKhttps://app.wapilot.io (requires the wapilot-sdk package on the server)
  4. Keep Phone Format on Digits only unless Wapilot requires the plus sign.
  5. Save, then click WhatsApp Diagnostics. The check does not send any message; it reports each step as Passed, Warning or Failed.
PDF attachments: Wapilot downloads the PDF from the site, so the site must be reachable from the internet. Advanced (API v2 payloads) should only be changed if the diagnostics or a test message indicate a different field name.

Guide: Test

Sends one message immediately to verify that a channel or a group is configured correctly.

ChannelAccepted Test Recipient
WhatsAppA mobile number (e.g. 01001234567) or a group id ending with @g.us.
Telegram (Bot)A chat id: a user's chat id from Telegram Link, or a group chat id such as -1001234567890.
Telegram (User Account)A mobile number registered on Telegram.

If the message fails, the error identifies the Issue and the Resolution, followed by the technical details.

fields.label: Test Recipient
fields.description: Mobile number, a Telegram chat id, or a WhatsApp group id ending with @g.us
